Blank a series after another series' last observation

truncate_to.Rd

Two series plotted together but published on different schedules leave the faster one apparently running ahead of the story. This blanks x for every period after the last one where reference has a value, so both lines end together.

Usage

truncate_to(x, reference)

Arguments

x

numeric vector to truncate

reference

numeric vector whose coverage sets the cutoff

Value

x, with everything after reference's last observation set to NA

Details

Meant to be called from a formula cell in chart_series.csv, with the reference series present as its own row with plot = FALSE — it then stays in the table build_chart_data returns, so the data export shows what caused the truncation. Positional, like every formula in a chart spec: it assumes the table is in period order.
